title: Mother with Four Children Outside Home, 1940s B&W Snapshot, USA
description: A clear post-WWII black-and-white family snapshot featuring a stylish mother posed with her four children—three young boys and a small girl in a white dress—outside a suburban home with a palm tree in the background. The mother wears a padded-shoulder suit jacket characteristic of late 1940s women's fashion. The photo features classic scalloped/deckled border edges.
